_comment_1: ArchViz preset library v4.0.0. Edit this file to add or modify presets.
_comment_2: Format: { category: { preset_name: prompt_text } }. Categories starting with _ are ignored.
_comment_3: Editing existing preset TEXT: changes apply on next workflow run, no restart needed.
_comment_4: ADDING new preset names: restart ComfyUI to refresh dropdown menus.
_design_philosophy: All presets use POSITIVE constraint phrasing because Gemini 3 Pro Image responds better to 'preserve X' than 'do not change X'. Avoid named real-world references (cities, brands, publications, photographers) — they trigger model recall of training data, which can produce watermarks or copyrighted reproductions in output.

preservation.preserve_exactly: Preserve the exact geometry, composition, proportions, fenestration pattern, and facade design shown in the input image. Maintain every architectural element, material logic, and structural relationship identically. Apply only surface-level photographic treatment as described below; do not invent, remove, or rearrange any architectural feature
preservation.people_only_minimal_change: This is a 'minimal change' edit: the ONLY modification permitted is adding human figures as specified by the people, population_density, and hero_style instructions. Every other pixel of the input image must remain identical — same lighting, same shadows, same materials, same colors, same sharpness, same composition, same level of detail, same atmosphere. Do NOT re-render, re-process, soften, smooth, dehaze, or aesthetically reinterpret any part of the input. Do NOT modify any furniture, surface, decor, lighting fixture, or architectural element. Treat the input as a finished photograph that you are adding people to via compositing. The output should be visually indistinguishable from the input except for the newly added human figures and their natural cast shadows on the floor or nearby surfaces
preservation.preserve_design: Preserve the geometry, composition, and overall design intent of the input image. Maintain proportions, window placement, facade rhythm, and structural elements. Refine only material specificity, lighting quality, and atmospheric context
preservation.preserve_with_polish: Preserve the architectural design, geometry, and composition of the input image. Maintain the building's form, fenestration, and proportions. Allow refinement of input artifacts (rough surfaces, draft-quality elements) into clean, finished material treatment while keeping all design decisions intact
preservation.restrained_realism: Apply restrained, credible treatment characteristic of professional architectural photography rather than competition-render theatrics. Use realistic lighting that respects the actual scene, natural color saturation, and a clean composition focused on the architecture itself
preservation.clean_minimal: Maintain a clean, considered composition focused on the architecture. Include only contextual elements that are appropriate for the building's use; avoid extraneous props, decorative additions, or visual clutter that would distract from the architectural subject
preservation.competition_polished: Apply competition-board presentation quality: confident framing, hero lighting that flatters the architecture, considered relationship between building and site, sufficient atmospheric depth without theatrical excess

people.qatari: of Qatari ethnicity, photographed in respectful documentary style. people.gulf_mixed: of mixed Gulf Arab ethnicity (Emirati, Saudi, Qatari, Omani, Kuwaiti, Bahraini), photographed in respectful documentary style. Traditional Gulf attire when figures are present: men wear white thobes/kanduras with regional ghutra styles; women wear elegant black abayas

population_density._comment: How many people and where they are placed in the frame.
population_density.single_hero: Include a single foreground figure as the compositional anchor of the scene, positioned thoughtfully to draw the eye while remaining secondary to the architecture
population_density.hero_with_supporting: Include a foreground hero figure as the primary compositional anchor, with two or three additional figures in the mid-ground and background interacting naturally with the space — adding life and depth without crowding
population_density.multiple_active: Include several figures distributed naturally across the foreground, mid-ground and background, each engaged with the space in their own way, creating a sense of the building as actively in use without any single dominant hero figure
population_density.crowded_public: Include many figures animating the space — small groups in conversation, individuals walking through, varied activity throughout the composition — communicating that the building is a busy public destination

hero_style._comment: What the hero figure is wearing/doing. Combine with population_density (single_hero or hero_with_supporting) and ethnicity to specify the compositional anchor.
hero_style.elegant_woman_flowing_dress: The hero figure is an elegant woman in a flowing light-colored dress (white, cream, soft pastel evening or cocktail dress, OR a flowing white/cream abaya with elegant embroidery for Gulf contexts), the fabric caught in mid-movement with soft motion suggesting natural walking, the dress catching air and light to create graceful flow lines that complement the architecture, the woman naturally inhabiting the space rather than posed
hero_style.elegant_man_tailored: The hero figure is a man in tailored attire — either a dark well-fitted suit without tie, or a smart-casual blazer with crisp shirt and chinos, OR a crisp white thobe/kandura for Gulf contexts. He is photographed walking through the space, contemplating the view, or holding a glass, integrated as if a resident of the building
hero_style.contemplative_figure_from_behind: The hero figure is a single person seen from behind, looking outward at the view through a window or balcony, anonymous in dark or neutral attire, allowing the viewer to project themselves into the figure's position. Works equally for a man or woman; the ethnicity is suggested through hair, build, and attire rather than facial features
hero_style.fashion_editorial_woman: The hero figure is a woman with theatrical fashion-editorial styling — light flowing dress (or elegant abaya in white/cream for Gulf contexts) caught dramatically in motion with the fabric arcing in the air, posed against the architecture in a way that turns her into a sculptural element. Magazine-photography quality, deliberately styled and lit
hero_style.couple_arrival_lifestyle: The hero is a couple walking together — woman on the man's arm or beside him, both in elegant smart-casual attire (or traditional Gulf attire if appropriate to the ethnicity), walking with natural pace toward the building entrance or through the space, communicating an aspirational residential lifestyle
hero_style.active_resident_lifestyle: The hero figure is engaged in a candid everyday luxury moment — pouring wine at a counter, reading in a chair near a window, walking through with coffee and phone, or in another natural lifestyle activity. Less posed than fashion-editorial, more lived-in. The figure reads as a resident, not a model

scale_life.family_activity: the activity reads as family-oriented: parents with children, casual movement, sense of welcoming residential space

scale_life.weathered_authentic: subtle authentic weathering and patina on architectural surfaces: wear patterns where humans naturally touch, slight irregularities showing real-world use, building feels lived-in rather than freshly delivered

enhancement.upscale_4k_full: Upscale this image to higher resolution and refine all details. Preserve the exact composition, geometry, lighting, materials, and design. Refine architectural surfaces, material textures, vegetation, sky, and figures with finer detail consistent with what is already shown. Keep all existing elements in their exact positions. Do not introduce new elements, change materials, alter the design, or shift the composition
enhancement.enhance_architecture_only: Refine and sharpen the architectural elements: facade details, material grain, edges, shadow definition, and surface variations. Improve the resolution and crispness of stone, plaster, timber, glass, and metal surfaces. Preserve the exact geometry, composition, and design — do not change the building's form, layout, fenestration, or material types. Only refine what is shown
enhancement.enhance_vegetation_strict: Refine the vegetation in the image — improve leaf detail, branch articulation, natural variation in foliage density, and realistic lighting on plant surfaces. Preserve the exact same plant species, positions, sizes, and densities shown in the input. Refine only the rendering quality of existing plants. Do not add, remove, or relocate any plant
enhancement.enhance_vegetation_creative: Refine and enrich the vegetation in the image — improve leaf detail, branch articulation, natural variation, and lushness. You may creatively enhance the planting by adding minor flowering accents, additional foliage texture, natural undergrowth, or subtle integrated landscape elements that complement the existing landscape design. Preserve the overall composition, primary plant species, and intent of the landscape. The result should feel like a more mature, well-maintained, and richer version of what is shown — not a different garden
enhancement.enhance_materials_textures: Refine surface materials and textures throughout the image: stone grain and travertine veining, timber wood grain, plaster texture, fabric weave, metal patina, glass clarity, fenestration detail. Preserve the exact materials, their positions, and the overall composition — do not change material types, only improve the rendering quality and tactile detail of what is already there
enhancement.enhance_people_full: Enhance the people in the image holistically so they read as natural, detailed, and photorealistic. Refine faces with sharp eye detail (visible iris texture, natural catchlights, symmetric pupils, eyelash detail), realistic skin micro-texture (visible pores at close range, natural color variation, subsurface scattering on highlight areas, no plastic or doll-like smoothness, no waxy appearance). Refine hair with anisotropic specular highlights along strand direction, visible individual strand separation, natural fall and natural variation in volume, realistic light interaction across the surface including subtle backlit translucency. Refine skin tones throughout with realistic chromatic variation (slightly warmer at cheeks and ears, slightly cooler at jaw), believable subsurface scattering. Refine clothing to show authentic fabric texture appropriate to the material — visible weave structure (linen showing slubs, cotton showing soft drape, wool showing matte fiber, silk showing satin sheen with directional highlights, cashmere showing soft halo of fine fibers, denim showing diagonal twill), natural drape from gravity, realistic wrinkles and stress folds at points of body articulation, accurate material weight and behavior. Refine posture and body language to read as relaxed and unposed, natural weight distribution. Fix any anatomical issues: hands with five correctly-proportioned fingers in natural positions, properly proportioned bodies, correct facial proportions, accurate joint articulation. Preserve each person's identity, ethnicity, clothing design and colors, and overall composition. Keep the architecture, lighting, and surroundings unchanged
enhancement.enhance_people_polish: Polish the surface quality of the people in the image without modifying their anatomy, pose, or position. Refine skin micro-texture with realistic pores and natural color variation (no plastic smoothness). Refine hair with anisotropic strand-direction highlights and visible individual strand separation. Refine clothing fabric with material-appropriate texture (visible weave for cotton/linen, sheen for silk, soft fiber halo for cashmere, diagonal twill for denim) and natural drape. Sharpen facial details including eyes with natural catchlights. Preserve all anatomy, hand positions, body proportions, posture, ethnicity, identity, clothing design, and colors exactly as shown
enhancement.fix_hands_only: Fix only the hands of the people in the image: ensure each hand has exactly five correctly-proportioned fingers in natural positions, no extra digits, no fused or distorted fingers, smooth wrist transitions, accurate knuckle articulation. Preserve faces, hair, skin, clothing, body proportions, identity, and all other elements of the image exactly as shown
enhancement.fix_faces_only: Refine only the faces of the people in the image: improve facial proportions, sharpen eye detail with visible iris texture and natural catchlights, ensure symmetric features, fix any softness or distortion, refine skin micro-texture on the face with realistic pores. Preserve each person's identity, ethnicity, expression, hairstyle, clothing, hands, body, and overall composition exactly
enhancement.motion_blur_figures: Render any human figures in the image as if photographed using a slow shutter speed while they were walking. Each figure should appear as ONE single opaque (not transparent, not see-through) figure with directional motion blur — the body's silhouette mostly intact but with limbs and clothing smearing into horizontal streaks in the direction of walking motion. The figure is one person photographed during their movement, NOT a static figure with a separate transparent ghost beside them, NOT a duplicate of the figure, NOT an overlay. Critically: do not produce double exposure, do not produce a sharp figure with a transparent copy next to it, do not produce ghostly transparent overlays. The result should look exactly like a real photograph taken with a 1/15 second shutter speed showing pedestrians walking past — recognizable as a human in motion, opaque and physical, smeared horizontally by their movement. Preserve the architecture, lighting, and composition exactly
enhancement.subtle_cleanup: Apply subtle refinement to the image: clean up minor rendering artifacts, soften over-sharpened edges, fix small visual inconsistencies. Preserve the composition, materials, lighting, design, and all elements exactly. The result should read as a slightly more polished version of the input — not a transformed image. Use a light touch; the goal is invisible improvement, not visible enhancement
